box.$description: The lowest-level layout primitive — a generic container exposing the surface/border/padding roles directly, with no fixed combination of its own (unlike Card, which picks one specific combination for content grouping). Radius isn't re-declared here: Box supports the full existing radius scale (tokens/primitives/radius.tokens.json) as-is, picked per use rather than fixed. Purely presentational, no interactive states — same as Separator.

surface.$description: Every semantic surface role except disabled (that one's a component-state concept, not a layout choice) — Box is how any of them gets used on a plain container.

border.$description: Optional hairline — Box's border is on/off, not a role choice (no hover/focus border here, this isn't an interactive field).

padding.$description: A curated subset of the dim scale, not the whole thing — these five cover what a generic container actually needs; anything more granular can still reach the raw dim.* tokens directly. Naming follows the same xs/sm/md/lg vocabulary as the radius scale.

xs.$description: 8px — the base gap, per dim's own legend.

md.$description: 16px — 'comfortable padding — card/input padding' per dim's own legend.

lg.$description: 24px — gap between distinct components, per dim's own legend.
